gate: GF-AGENT (mapping learner): teacher round on the D1f dictionary-documented columns
role: development teacher: labels only; no verification, training or evaluation in this session

labels.lineShape: { profileId, field: { target, operation, confidence, rationale } }
labels.methodInLine: none: the verifier's line shape is closed, so the method id is recorded here

selfCheck.scope: format only; scripts/agent/verify-teacher-labels.ts was not run
checks: every line parses and has exactly the keys of the line shape
profile ids match profiles.jsonl one to one, in order
every target is a mapping target and every operation is allowed for it, with allowed parameters
every positive rationale carries its own dictionary locator
every quoted passage in a positive is verbatim from the definition and at most 20 words
a header-only positive is at or below 0.6
a positive target appears once per table (the validator's MAPPING_TARGET_DUPLICATE rule)
UTF-8, LF line ends, no byte-order mark

readFrom.catalogueDump: tsx import of the two contracts modules at the baseline; not transcribed by hand

link_parent_key.parentField: a source field of the supplied parent inventory

operationRulesAsRead: an operation must be in the target's allowedOperations
identifier targets and unknown are copy only
parse_literal: text_literal for text, number for quantities, date_dmy or date_iso for dates
enum_lookup must name the code-owned table of its target
unit_convert needs the same declared unit on the profiled column
link_parent_key needs a supplied parent inventory (none in this round)
one table plan carries a target other than unknown at most once

catalogueTargetMeanings.building.sourceKey: Identifier copied verbatim from the issuing source; not an allocated application ID.
catalogueTargetMeanings.building.name: Building name as stated in the source.
catalogueTargetMeanings.building.addressLiteral: Unresolved address text as written; not a geocoded location.
catalogueTargetMeanings.building.use: Source-stated use, not a legal-use determination.
catalogueTargetMeanings.building.storeyLabel: Literal storey expression; G+41 is not automatically a count.
catalogueTargetMeanings.building.storeyCount: Explicit source count; never derived from a floor label.
catalogueTargetMeanings.building.heightM: Source height in metres; vertical reference still needs separate evidence.
catalogueTargetMeanings.building.footprint: Retained source polygon in its source CRS; no reprojection or ground/roof role is inferred.
catalogueTargetMeanings.parcel.khasra: Literal khasra identifier, including slashes and local-script digits.
catalogueTargetMeanings.parcel.plot: Literal plot identifier; not a building identifier.
catalogueTargetMeanings.parcel.survey: Literal survey identifier with its source formatting.
catalogueTargetMeanings.parcel.ulpinAnchor: A source-copied official parcel-anchor assertion, never issuance or verification.
catalogueTargetMeanings.parcel.area: Source-stated parcel area with declared units; not polygon-derived title area.
catalogueTargetMeanings.unit.unitNo: Literal unit identifier as written in the source.
catalogueTargetMeanings.unit.floorLabel: Literal floor label; does not establish integer level or unit extent.
catalogueTargetMeanings.unit.carpetArea: Only source-declared carpet area; generic room area is not statutory carpet area.
catalogueTargetMeanings.unit.builtUpArea: Source-declared built-up area, distinct from carpet area.
catalogueTargetMeanings.unit.balconyArea: Source-declared balcony area, kept separate from carpet area.
catalogueTargetMeanings.level.label: Literal level label; G, UGF, Stilt and B1 never become integers.
catalogueTargetMeanings.level.kind: Source-stated level category; no inferred floor schedule.
catalogueTargetMeanings.level.lowerM: Source lower elevation in metres; requires a separate vertical reference.
catalogueTargetMeanings.level.upperM: Source upper elevation in metres; requires a separate vertical reference.
catalogueTargetMeanings.space.name: Literal room or space name; a room is not automatically a legal unit.
catalogueTargetMeanings.space.area: Source-stated space area; not statutory unit carpet area.
catalogueTargetMeanings.document.registrationNo: Literal source registration number; no new registration is allocated.
catalogueTargetMeanings.document.sanctionNo: Literal source sanction number; not proof of current validity.
catalogueTargetMeanings.document.date: Unambiguous source date with the original literal retained.
catalogueTargetMeanings.document.issuer: Issuer named in the source; no authority is inferred.
catalogueTargetMeanings.document.status: Source-declared document status, not an application review decision.
catalogueTargetMeanings.building.parentSourceKey: Source-backed parent key; linkage requires referential-integrity checking.
catalogueTargetMeanings.unit.parentSourceKey: Source-backed parent building key; does not infer a unit-floor relation.
catalogueTargetMeanings.space.parentSourceKey: Source-backed parent level or unit key; relationship meaning needs review.
catalogueTargetMeanings.unknown: Retain the source field without assigning unsupported canonical meaning.

decisionRule: 1 positive only when definition, masked samples and a catalogue target of that exact meaning agree
2 defined but no catalogue target: unknown
3 no dictionary row, or a row that only restates the header: label only if unmistakable, at most 0.6
5 a point, centroid or parcel boundary is not a building footprint

confidenceBins.edges: left-closed fifths; the last bin includes 1.0
confidenceBins.note: the six header-only positives sit at the 0.6 cap set by rule 3, not at a free estimate

nearFitFormat: profile id: family, target considered, reason code (see nearFitReasons)

nearFitReasons.type_class: A type classification, not a stated use; the primary use has its own column.
nearFitReasons.parcel_sl: Assessor's parcel number; the slash shape only resembles a khasra. Not a plot or survey number.
nearFitReasons.parcel_id: An assessor or tax parcel identifier: not a plot, survey or khasra number, nor a ULPIN.
nearFitReasons.whole_gfa: Whole-property gross floor area, not a unit's built-up area.
nearFitReasons.part_use: Use of the largest part only; the primary use has its own column (one target per table).
nearFitReasons.compliance: A compliance state under a reporting rule, not the status of a document.
nearFitReasons.estate: Name of a multi-building development, not of a building.
nearFitReasons.abbrev: The definition only expands the abbreviation; no parent rows are supplied.
nearFitReasons.scoped_no: The number repeats across developments; the identification column carries the key.
nearFitReasons.tax_block: A tax block groups lots; it is not a plot identifier.
nearFitReasons.tax_lot: A tax lot within a block is a neighbour of the plot number; definition barely beyond the header.
nearFitReasons.year_key: Keys one yearly record (parcel number with year), not a building.
nearFitReasons.exchanged: Rule 4: the category and property-type dictionary rows appear exchanged; no row fits its values.
nearFitReasons.deadline: A compliance deadline, not a document date; day and month order not established.
nearFitReasons.point: A point location, not the building's outline.
nearFitReasons.use_list: Lists every use at the property; the main use has its own column.
nearFitReasons.heritage: A heritage designation of the resource, not the status of a document.
nearFitReasons.zoning: No dictionary row; zoning is a planning rule for land, not the building's stated use.
